To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the definition of a data scientist is that of a data analyst with a strong background in computer science and statistics.

the job of a self claimed data scientist can be defined as a combination of the following skill sets: 1) data mining, 2) machine learning, 3) statistics, and 4) programming, with the following job functions: 1) modeling, 2) visualization, 3) communication, and 4 ) project management.

the job of a Data Scientist can be defined as a job that requires the following skills: 1) data mining, 2) machine learning, 3) statistical modeling, 4) big data technologies, and 5) data visualization.

the question of how to find a perfect data scientist and we believe it will help companies to efficiently recruit data scientists and help data scientist candidates to better position themselves.

a proper definition of data scientists is: a person who has an undergraduate degree in a quantitative field and a graduate degree in computer science or statistics, who has experience in programming and data mining, and who has a strong interest in data visualization.
data scientists are individuals who have a background in computer science, mathematics, and statistics, and who can apply their skills to solve real life business problems.

a data scientist can be defined as a professional who is proficient in the fields of computer science, statistics, mathematics, and domain knowledge, and is capable of solving real world problems with data.
